artGeneration: Built-in image generation; original monochrome campaign illustration using the installed Grenadier unit portrait as costume reference. Prompt: full-body Jurchen Grenadier, conical helmet, studded coat, spiked grenade, historical ink crosshatching on pure white.

paragraphs: The Grenadier is a Jurchen gunpowder soldier who hurls explosive bombs into enemy formations.
From the forests of northeast Asia, the Jurchens founded the Jin dynasty and conquered much of northern China. Their armies combined armored cavalry with powerful early gunpowder weapons.
Grenades burst across an area, threatening tightly packed enemies rather than just a single target.
With Thunderclap Bombs, explosions leave further blasts behind, and fallen Grenadiers can still harm nearby enemies. Even after the first impact, a crowded battlefield remains dangerous.
